freeze_point: source set selected after abstract-level discovery and before full-text extraction and per-source classification
purpose: Test whether a fixed primary-source set contains a natural HoTT/Cubical use that makes one Path or cubical dimension serve as an activity-time carrier and also promises exact observation of a discrete completion event without a separate event structure.

answer_visibility.limitation: The current AI had already read the local L3 bridge assessment and abstract-level search results. This is a bounded evidence audit, not a blind literature review or a proof that no such consumer exists elsewhere.

hit_criteria.question: Does the source actually use Path or a cubical dimension as the carrier of an activity's time, rather than as equality, homotopy, geometry or proof dimension?
Does the same construction promise exact observation of a discrete completion or arrival event through that carrier?
Is there no separate clock, tick, later modality, event type, stage type, directed morphism or external scheduler carrying temporal progression?
Does the extra completion obligation arise from the HoTT/Cubical rule actually used, rather than from ordinary continuous modeling or an independently chosen topology?
Does the source present the capability without an explicit assumption, approximation qualifier, partial interface or statement that the required structure is additional?
Does the source treat failure of exact completion as a fact about the original activity rather than a limitation of its chosen representation?

decision_rule: A natural-consumer hit requires PASS on E1-E6 in one fixed source/construction. Any FAIL prevents a hit. UNKNOWN remains unresolved. The final negative conclusion, if any, is restricted to this seven-source set and these versions.

exclusions: secondary surveys and informal social-media discussion

keyword matches in bibliographies or prose that do not define the relevant construction
